# Belgium

[global-law](../) / Belgium

3 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 2 legislation, subdivisions). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 75% | 0.0% | 29% | 0% |

Small federal core with real in-force history: the Constitution and 17 major codes and laws (29 folders, 18 distinct acts) out of roughly 60,000 consolidated texts. The Code pénal folder still holds the 1867 code although the new Code pénal took effect on 2026-09-01. Only 2 of 7 legislating federated bodies are held (Flanders, partly; the German-speaking Community, 9 acts), and there is no case law.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
